decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed creation of 12 residential units outside the town centre is considered to be an excessive development of this small backland site, with an excessive residential density, resulting in an inadequate standard and layout of residential accommodation for future occupiers, inadequate amenity space provision, problems of refuse collection and storage, and noise and vibration, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, ENV-B 1.8, H 1.1, H 4.1, H 4.2, H 4.4, H 5.1, H 6.3, T 1.1 and T 1.4 of the Unitary Development Plan.  

2.	The density, scale and layout of the residential proposed would lead to unacceptable loss of amenity to existing residents, through overlooking, loss of outlook and loss of privacy, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, H 4.1 and H 4.2 of the Unitary Development Plan

3.	The proposed residential development does not create an inclusive residential development, in particular no provision being made for housing for people with disabilities contrary to policy 4B.5 of the London Plan and policy H 5.1 of the Unitary Development Plan  

4.	The proposed development, by virtue of its shape, form, massing and location would not be compatible with or enhance the character of the area in terms of size, scale and design, contrary to Policy ENV-B 1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan, and the advice given in PPS 1 and the London Plan.

5.	The proposed development would not preserve or enhance the character or appearance of Grove Park Conservation Area, contrary to Policy ENV B-2.2 of the Unitary Development Plan.

6.	The proposed arrangements for vehicular access for the proposed increase in intensity of use of the site are considered to be unsafe, and the provision for loading, unloading and servicing to the rear to be inadequate, and are likely to give rise to conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic on the public highway and increase in danger for traffic and pedestrians, contrary to policies ENV-B 1.1, T 1.4 and T 4.3 of the Unitary Development
description: Demolition of existing buildings and the erection of a part three storey part  two storey block comprising 4 one bedroom flats, 6 two bedroom flats, and 2 studio flats with associated parking, bicycle stand, and landscaping
